name: Atlantic Forest South-East Reserves
description: Along the coast of southern São Paulo and Paraná states, 25 protected areas cover about 470,000 hectares of what remains of Brazil's Atlantic forest. Once a rainforest rivaling the Amazon in size, it has lost most of its original area, and here you can still see it intact. The landscape runs from misty forested mountains to wetlands, dunes and rugged coastal islands.
